svg.title: The fine-tuning ladder: prompt engineering, then RAG, then fine-tuning — each step costs more and is less reversible
svg.desc: Three ascending steps. The lowest and first step is prompt engineering: cheapest, instant, fully reversible, and it got the base model about 80 percent of the way. The middle step is RAG: adds a retrieval system, and it is what installs facts. The top and last step is fine-tuning: a GPU job that is costly, hard to reverse, and locks you to open-weight models; it changes form, not facts. An arrow along the steps shows cost and irreversibility rising from bottom-left to top-right. A caption reads: fine-tuning is the third thing you try, not the first.
svg.text: The ladder: prompt engineering → RAG → fine-tuning
cheap · instant · fully reversible — got the base model ~80% there
adds a retrieval system — this is what installs facts
a GPU job · hard to reverse · locks you to open weights
cost & irreversibility rising → · each step fixes a different problem
